name: Photo House VR
summary:
Have you ever wanted to walk through your photo album? To pull up a memory and truly feel like you're back in it? With Photo House VR, now you can.

Load your photos into a virtual 2-story house, and place them anyway you want — on the walls, big or small, wherever they feel right. Stretch a single photo to the size of a truck, or fill an entire wall with 50 memories at once. Your photos deserve more than a 6-inch screen.

Step Inside Your 360° Photos
